candidates.title: U.S. President wants 60 days to analyse impact of Russia sanctions law, says Marco Rubio
candidates.excerpt: On October 16, Mr. Trump waived key provisions of the Graham Act that authorised punitive tariffs on countries purchasing Russian oil, offering relief to India

candidates.title: China considers new export curbs on solar, AI, biotech
candidates.excerpt: The draft plan, “Announcement No. 48”, proposes a complete export ban on 14 technologies and restrictions on 26 more, including next-generation solar technologies that could affect countries such as India seeking to reduce dependence on China

candidates.title: Unanswered questions at IIT Bombay after Sahil Wakode’s suicide
candidates.excerpt: Mumbai: Sahil Wakode’s parents say caste abuse drove their son to his death. The faculty body says the professor they accuse only followed exam rules. A month on, the campus is divided. On the afternoon Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Bombay’s director wrote to students to say a senior professor had been relieved of his post …

candidates.title: Earthquake of 6.9 magnitude hits near Ozernovskiy in Russia
candidates.excerpt: Scientists estimated its magnitude at 6.5 at first, but later revised it to 6.9. It was felt as a magnitude-5 earthquake in the region, says Geological Survey
